law: G8 freeze-before-measurement / A7-F2 P-12 law: this ENUMERATED + HASHED inventory is committed BEFORE any rho exists. The D2 measurement loads this file, verifies its sha256 against the constant pinned in the measurement code, and REFUSES (fail-closed) on any mismatch. Measuring against an under-enumerated inventory is an invalid PASS. The 0.20 bar is immovable (G9, no-threshold-rescue).
authority: research/control/ng6_ng7_ng4_dossiers_2026-09/sng6-a4-hostile-critic-dossier.json (BINDING axes 1/2/3/4: event-conditional forms, vol tercile + vol-restricted, dvol-shock at the event-conditional population, calendar-geometry state maps)
frozen_utc: 2026-09-16 (before any rho; D1 freeze already committed; no return of the anchor computed anywhere in this cycle)
representation: ONE adjusted-EOD single representation (P-12): per-session factor f_t = adjusted_close_t/close_t; adjusted OHLC = raw x f_t; every shadow state below is computed on the SAME adjusted series, per-name SERVED-session basis (trailing windows run over served sessions, identical to the anchor identity basis), on the frozen SPY-served-session decision grid of folds.json (2943 sessions, 2015-01-02..2026-09-16). All shadow features are TRAILING (session-t close information); NO forward return of any book is computed anywhere in D2.

targets.anchor_book_state: SNG6-A2-P1-ANCHOR-TRAP-RECLAIM book state per the d1_freeze construction: BOOKABLE anchor events only; position held on served sessions [t+1 .. t+10] (entry t+1 open, exit t+11 open, H=10); force-flat at fold boundary (footprint limited to the ENTRY session's fold) and at name death (sessions beyond the last served session do not exist)
targets.neighbour_book_state: SNG6-A2-P1-NEIGH-CONFIRM-2S book state: bookable anchor events with the 2-session confirmation (adj_close_{t+1} > the broken prior 252-session low), entry t+2 open, held [t+2 .. t+11], same fold/death truncation

rho_form: pooled Pearson AND pooled Spearman (tie-averaged ranks) between the shadow state series and each target book state on the frozen grid; cohort-wide form = all (name, served-session) pairs where the shadow is finite; EVENT-CONDITIONAL form (BINDING where marked) = the same pairs restricted to the union of BOOKABLE anchor event windows [t_ev .. t_ev+10]; A4: a cohort-wide rho understates a sparse event book, so the conditional forms are the applicable ones where marked BINDING
bar: pooled |rho| > 0.20 vs ANY applicable shadow -> R0 pre-score ancestry veto (immovable; margin-to-bar = 0.20 - |rho| reported for every applicable rho)

entries.name: momentum_63s_generic
entries.construction: mom63_{i,t} = adj_close_t / adj_close_{t-62} - 1 (63 served sessions inclusive; needs i >= 62)

entries.name: momentum_12_1_xsec
entries.construction: mom12_1_{i,t} = (adj_close_t/adj_close_{t-251} - 1) - (adj_close_t/adj_close_{t-20} - 1) (252-session trailing minus 21-session trailing); cross-sectionally z-scored per grid session over names with a finite value (z preserved in the verdict; Spearman is invariant to the monotone per-session standardization)
entries.representation: adjusted, served-session basis, cross-sectional z state

entries.name: reversal_5d_21d_eventconditional
entries.plan_item: EVENT-CONDITIONAL 5d/21d trailing-return reversal states (A4 axis 1 BINDING)
entries.construction: rev5_{i,t} = adj_close_t/adj_close_{t-4} - 1; rev21_{i,t} = adj_close_t/adj_close_{t-20} - 1; BOTH the cohort-wide pooled rho AND the BINDING event-conditional rho are measured and reported

entries.name: drawdown_depth_252_eventconditional
entries.construction: dd252_{i,t} = 1 - adj_close_t / max(adj_close over served sessions t-251..t) (A4 formula verbatim: 1 - close/252-session-max); cohort-wide AND BINDING event-conditional forms both reported
entries.representation: adjusted, served-session basis, continuous state in [0,1)

entries.name: dvol_shock_eventconditional
entries.plan_item: EVENT-CONDITIONAL dollar-volume-shock state (A4 axis 3 BINDING; CNG1 generic_dvol_shock analog, V4 A5-H2 class)
entries.construction: dvolshock_{i,t} = dvol_t / median(dvol over served sessions t-60..t-1), dvol_t = adj_close_t * volume_t (the anchor's own participation observable); cohort-wide AND BINDING event-conditional forms both reported
entries.representation: adjusted, served-session basis, positive continuous state

entries.name: vol_tercile_and_vol_restricted_event
entries.plan_item: EVENT-CONDITIONAL vol-tercile + vol-restricted event states (A4 axis 2 BINDING; 20d/60d both declared ex ante)
entries.construction: rv20_{i,t}/rv60_{i,t} = sample stdev (ddof=1) of the trailing 20/60 served-session daily adjusted close-to-close returns. Four BINDING forms: (a) voltercile20_book / voltercile60_book: grid book state, 1 iff rv is in the TOP cross-sectional tercile among names with a finite rv at that grid session (else 0), pooled vs target on the grid; (b) volrestricted20_event / volrestricted60_event: footprint book state of ONLY those BOOKABLE anchor events whose rv20/rv60 at the event session is in the top cross-sectional tercile at that session, pooled vs target on the grid
entries.representation: adjusted, served-session basis, tercile book states + event-restricted footprints

entries.name: realized_vol_level
entries.construction: rv20_{i,t} and rv60_{i,t} as defined above, measured as LEVEL states (not terciles); cohort-wide pooled rho

entries.name: semivariance_share
entries.construction: svshare_{i,t} = sum(min(r,0)^2) / sum(r^2) over the trailing 60 served-session daily adjusted returns r; cohort-wide AND event-conditional forms both reported
entries.representation: adjusted, served-session basis, continuous state in [0,1]

entries.name: rolling_beta_state
entries.construction: beta63_{i,t} = rolling OLS beta of the name's daily adjusted return on SPY's daily adjusted return over the trailing 63 GRID sessions aligned to the name's served sessions; requires >= 40 of the 63 sessions served by the name, else undefined; cohort-wide pooled rho
entries.representation: adjusted, grid-aligned served basis, continuous state

entries.name: dgs10_level_state
entries.construction: a 10-year Treasury yield LEVEL state. NOT constructible from the P0 price/volume cache: the cache contains no rates/bond series (evidence: full symbol scan recorded in the verdict), and this cycle's P0 staged no exogenous rates authority (unlike STOCKS-NG5, whose FRED staging belongs to that cycle's authority). Recorded UNMEASURABLE fail-closed, never skipped silently.
entries.representation: cross-plane template; no in-cycle representation exists

entries.name: event_calendar_geometry
entries.plan_item: event DOW/month-end geometry (P-24 class; A4 axis 4b state maps)
entries.construction: three deterministic grid state maps, all declared ex ante: (a) dow_state_t = observed share of BOOKABLE anchor events whose decision-session weekday == weekday(t) (5-valued deterministic event-histogram map); (b) monthstart_state_t = 1 iff t is the first SPY-grid session of its calendar month; (c) monthend_state_t = 1 iff t is the last SPY-grid session of its calendar month; each pooled vs each target; EVERY applicable rho under this entry is subject to the 0.20 bar

entries.name: v13_death_event_proximity
entries.construction: per dead cohort member: death_idx = last served session with date <= the member's death_filing_date_evidence; state = 1 on served sessions [death_idx-10 .. death_idx], else 0; cohort-wide pooled rho

entries.name: ng5_relative_breadth_rotation_state
entries.construction: NG5's own frozen anchor ANCHOR-TREND-L13 (research/control/stocks_ng5_run/d1/d1_proposal_freeze.json): s_t = 0.5*(ln(P_qqew/P_qqq) + ln(P_rsp/P_spy)) at the last session of each ISO week; m_t = s_t - s_{t-13}; z_t = m_t / stdev(trailing 104 weekly m, ddof=1); z_t >= 0 -> hold QQQ, z_t < 0 -> hold SPY for the coming week; undefined z carries the prior leg (NG5's own fail-closed rule). The weekly leg is mapped onto the frozen grid (QQQ-leg = 1, SPY-leg = 0). Data: NG5's sha-pinned P0 staging (QQEW/QQQ/RSP/SPY), each file re-hashed at measurement time against the committed pins in NG5's P0 verdict F9 block (28119258…, ff204ad3…, c27a1c2f…, 7a66f450…) — prior-cycle committed evidence, cited as P-1 prior evidence by this cycle's plan §4; mismatch = refusal
entries.representation: NG5 sha-verified adjusted ETF staging mapped to the frozen grid; binary leg state

entries.name: dividend_decomposition_divergence
entries.construction: the anchor event census is recomputed IDENTICALLY on the RAW (unadjusted) price basis (raw OHLC; dvol = raw close * volume; floors on raw close). Check: (a) event-set overlap fractions |A∩R|/|A| and |R∩A|/|R| keyed by (symbol, decision date); (b) pooled Pearson+Spearman rho between the adjusted-basis and raw-basis anchor book states on the grid. DECLARED EX ANTE flag (frozen here, before any measurement): DISTRIBUTION_DOMINATED (fail-closed contamination flag, non-scored) iff min(|A∩R|/|A|, |R∩A|/|R|) < 0.80. The flag is recorded either way; this entry consumes no scored slot and carries no 0.20 bar
entries.representation: adjusted vs raw representation of the SAME construction
